newsitem.title: USA: Vanguard Air September load factor up.
newsitem.headline: Vanguard Air September load factor up.

text.p: Vanguard Airlines Inc said Friday its September passenger load factor rose 3.63 points to 50.24 percent from 46.61 percent a year ago.
It said revenue passenger miles advanced 110.2 percent to 48 million from 22.8 million, and available seat miles increased 95 percent to 95.5 million from 49 million a year ago.

Year to date, the carrier said its load factor increased 11.4 points to 63.52 percent from 52.12 percent. Revenue passenger miles were up 148.9 percent, to 523.9 million and available seat miles gained 104.2 percent to 824.8 million.
